entries.title: Her Story

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version preserves the desktop police-database interface and is the best capture route for the FMV/search experience. Mac, iOS, and Android versions do not add sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Her Story on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play with keyboard/mouse search input.

entries.title: Immortality

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best high-fidelity capture route for Immortality's interactive film footage and match-cut interface. Xbox, mobile/Netflix, Mac, and PS5 ports do not add sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Immortality on Steam, GOG, or the Xbox PC/Microsoft Store route for Windows PC; Netflix mobile and console versions are valid alternate access routes.
